<a id="acid_articulate"></a>
## Articulate: `15_acid_articulate.yml`

An acid house line played the whole way through, whose notes lengthen from short blips into
long, gliding, joined notes over each scene while its filter opens, with no gate changed. The demo sets Articulate on the scenes, on the line itself and as a generator that bounces between short
and long every bar, and a register bound to CC 74 opens the filter as the notes lengthen.

<a id="acid_glide"></a>
## Glide and Shorten: `14_acid_glide.yml`

Fluid acid techno for a synth with portamento: one sixteen-note acid line from start to finish,
and Glide and Shorten rows of 5, 7 and 3 steps putting its slides and short notes somewhere new
each bar, though the line itself never changes.

<a id="edm_density"></a>
## Density: `edm_density.yml`

A club track at 128 beats a minute in F minor whose every intro, build, breakdown and drop comes
from Density, which keeps a share of a clip's notes, the strongest places in the bar first. The
same seven patterns, each written at the busiest it will ever play, run through every scene, and
only the densities change: the scenes' own ramps fill the intro and the builds in and strip the
outro away, and four Density generators, sparse, half, rise and fall, thin the breakdown, turn
the drums half time and make the arp and the lead trade places across the second drop.

<a id="ode_to_joy_ratchet"></a>
## Ratchets: `11_ode_to_joy_ratchet.yml`

The first line of Ode to Joy, slowed down to long notes, and then chopped up. The scenes named
Ratchet use a pattern's own Ratchet, Ratchet offset and Probability rows. The scenes named
AutoRatchet leave the pattern alone and do the chopping in a chain instead.

<a id="registers"></a>
## Registers: `22_registers.yml`

An acid techno riff of five notes, changed bar by bar by the four registers, AX to DX. AX, BX
and CX each move a different note of the riff, in cycles of 4, 6 and 5 bars, then all three
at once. Then DX fades the riff, kick and hat out together over six repeats of the last scene.

<a id="sailor_arpeggiator"></a>
## Arpeggiator: `12_sailor_arpeggiator.yml`

The verse of What Shall We Do With the Drunken Sailor, with its chords played through a different
arpeggiator in every scene: step lengths, orders, octave ranges and jumps, offsets, and then
combinations of them. The tune plays alongside, plainly, so you can mute it and hear only the
arpeggio.

<a id="sandworm"></a>
## Trance Builds by Density: `sandworm.yml`

A late-nineties trance anthem in the manner of Sandstorm, with a stuttering sixteenth-note lead of
its own. Each build is a scene whose Density rises from 25% to 100%, thinning every clip to its
strongest beats and filling it back in.

<a id="tie"></a>
## Ties: `08_tie.yml`

An original downtempo piece in D Mixolydian whose pad draws its chords with the Tie row rather
than with gates, so a chord lasts as long as the ties that follow it, and whose ending holds a
bass note with ties alone, longer than any gate could make it. The demo also brings in the tracks one at a time, morphs a tune into its answer, grabs an echo and slides a filter, so it's the closest
thing here to a finished song.
